_help: 'Did you mean...?' (control/confirm.py). {phrase} is the command she half-recognised, for example 'open galaxy map'.
CommandConfirm: I think you said {phrase}. Is that right?
Not quite sure I caught that. {phrase}?
CommandConfirm_Sarcastic: I'm guessing {phrase}. Am I right, or shall I keep guessing?
CommandConfirmNo: Okay, never mind. Say it again whenever you're ready.
Right, I'll drop it. Say it once more, maybe a bit slower.
CommandConfirmNo_Close: That's all right, love. Say it again.
